provenance.evaluation: GT segmentation polygon for region-colour ground truth

decision.reason: Unambiguous GT dominant color in only 4/10 targets; only 5/10 target spatial matches from top3; too few paired color cases. Cannot claim safe object properties from RGB center.
decision.action: Stop this approximate RGB region descriptor; retain numeric report, remove prototype & workflow.
decision.correction: Rectangular box aspect ratio is NOT real object shape; 1.3ms CPU for two descriptors is not proof of accurate object property, nor of RK3566 feasibility.
